reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration plugin that imports local coding-provider configurations, supports compatible OAuth login, discovers gateway models, and makes selected models available in DSH.

summaries.zh: 用于将本地编码平台登录状态和供应商配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，并通过 OAuth 与兼容网关发现和管理可用模型。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for importing local coding-provider login state and configuration, supporting compatible OAuth flows, and discovering models from supported gateways.

capabilities: Reads local provider configuration and login state
Supports OAuth authentication for compatible providers
Imports and exposes provider models in the DSH model picker
